question_text_original: Consider the curve $C_{1}: y=2^{x-1}$ ,where $x>0$ .Denote the origin by $O$ .Let $P(u, v)$ be a moving point on $C_{1}$ such that the area of the circle with $O P$ as a radius decreases at a constant rate of $8 \pi$ square units per second.The vertical line passing through $P$ cuts the $x$－axis at the point $Q$ . question_text_zh: 考虑曲线 $C_{1}: y=2^{x-1}$ ,其中 $x>0$ 。将原点记为 $O$ 。设 $P(u, v)$ 为 $C_{1}$ 上的一动点使得以$O P$ 为一半径的圆的面积以每秒 $8 \pi$ 平方单位的恒速率减少。通过 $P$ 的垂直线与 $x$ 轴相交于点 $Q$ 。求当 $u=2$ 时 $\triangle O P Q$ 面积的变率。
question_latex: Consider the curve $C_{1}: y=2^{x-1}$ ,where $x>0$ .Denote the origin by $O$ .Let $P(u, v)$ be a moving point on $C_{1}$ such that the area of the circle with $O P$ as a radius decreases at a constant rate of $8 \pi$ square units per second.The vertical line passing through $P$ cuts the $x$－axis at the point $Q$ . Find the rate of change of the area of $\triangle O P Q$ when $u=2$ .
solution_original:
Let $A$ square units be the area of the circle with $O P$ as a radius.
設 $A$ 平方單位為以 $O P$ 為半徑的圓的面積。
\[
A=\pi(u^{2}+v^{2}),\qquad
\frac{dA}{dt}=\pi\left(2u\frac{du}{dt}+2v\frac{dv}{dt}\right)=-8\pi.
\]
Hence
\[
u\frac{du}{dt}+v\frac{dv}{dt}=-4,
\qquad v=2^{u-1},
\]
and therefore
\[
\frac{du}{dt}=\frac{-4}{u+2^{2u-2}\ln 2}.
\]
At \(u=2\), \(\frac{du}{dt}=\frac{-2}{1+2\ln2}\).

Let $S$ square units be the area of $\triangle O P Q$ .
設 $S$ 平方單位為 $\triangle O P Q$ 的面積。
$$
\begin{gathered}
S=\frac{1}{2} u v=\frac{1}{2} u\left(2^{u-1}\right)=u 2^{u-2} \\
\frac{d S}{d t}=\left[u(\ln 2) 2^{u-2}+2^{u-2}\right] \frac{d u}{d t} \\
=(1+u \ln 2) 2^{u-2} \frac{d u}{d t} \\
\left.\frac{d S}{d t}\right|_{u=2}=\left.(1+2 \ln 2) \frac{d u}{d t}\right|_{u=2} \\
=(1+2 \ln 2)\left(\frac{-2}{1+2 \ln 2}\right) \\
=-2
\end{gathered}
$$
$\therefore \quad$ The required rate of change is－2 square units per second.
所求的變率為每秒－2平方單位。

Consider the curve $C: y=4 \ln x$ ,where $x>1$ .Let $O$ be the origin and $P$ be a point lying on $C$ .The vertical line which passes through $P$ cuts the $x$－axis at the point $Q$ .Denote the $x$－coordinate of $Q$ by $u$ .
(a) Express the area of $\triangle O P Q$ in terms of $u$ .

考虑曲线 $C: y=4 \ln x$ ,其中 $x>1$ 。设 $O$ 为原点及 $P$ 为 $C$ 上的一点。通过 $P$ 的垂直线与 $x$ 轴相交于点 $Q$ 。将 $Q$ 的 $x$ 坐标记为 $u$ 。
(a) 以 $u$ 表 $\triangle O P Q$ 的面积。
(b) 若 $P$ 沿 $C$ 移动使得 $P Q$ 以每秒4单位的恒速率减少,求当 $u=e$ 时 $\triangle O P Q$ 的面积的变率。

14.Reference：HKDSE Math M2 2016 Q3
(a) 
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text { Area } & =\frac{1}{2}(u)(4 \ln u) \text { square units } \\
& =\underline{\underline{2 u \ln u \text { square units }}}
\end{aligned}
$$
1A
(b) Let $v$ units be the length of $P Q$ and $A$ square units be the area of $\triangle O P Q$ .
$$
\begin{aligned}
& v=4 \ln u \\
& \therefore \quad \frac{d v}{d t}=\frac{4}{u} \times \frac{d u}{d t}
\end{aligned}
$$
Note that $\frac{d v}{d t}=-4$ .When $u=e$ ,we have
$$
-4=\frac{4}{e} \times\left.\frac{d u}{d t}\right|_{u=e}
$$
i.e.
$$
\left.\frac{d u}{d t}\right|_{u=e}=-e
$$
1A
$A=2 u \ln u$
$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{d A}{d t} & =\left(2 u \times \frac{1}{u}+2 \ln u\right) \times \frac{d u}{d t} \\
& =(2+2 \ln u) \frac{d u}{d t}
\end{aligned}
$$
$\left.\frac{d A}{d t}\right|_{u=e}=(2+2 \ln e)(-e)$
$$
=-4 e
$$
$\therefore \quad$ The rate of change of the area of $\triangle O P Q$ is $-4 e$ square units per second. 1A
